name: Scappa via con me, Imperatrice! [Run Away With Me, Empress!]
source:
Enrolled in a super-exclusive school full of beauties, take advantage of your luck ♥

You've been scouted to attend the most prestigious, exclusive school of the nation, surrounded by girls at least as beautiful as you (and you're pretty good-looking). Years of hard work have finally paid off.

You and your peers are to be "shaped up to accompany the élite of society". You've been told you'll get assigned an Emperor's Title at one point, but most of your breathtakingly beautiful classmates already have one. In the meanwhile, maybe you can get closer to one of them...?

[From [url=https://crescendo.itch.io/emperors-lesbian-new-groove]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你进入了一所美女如云、极其高端的学校，好好把握这份好运吧♥

你受到邀请，来到全国最负盛名、门槛最高的学校。身边的女孩至少与你一样美丽，而你本来就颇有姿色。多年的努力终于得到了回报。

你和同伴们将被“培养成陪伴社会精英的人”。校方告诉你，某个时候会授予你一个“皇帝头衔”，不过，你那些美得令人屏息的同学，大多已经有了头衔。在等待的这段日子里，也许你能与其中一位更加亲近……？

（来源：[url=https://crescendo.itch.io/emperors-lesbian-new-groove]itch.io[/url]）
